verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a compliance SaaS that ships an AI feature (Compliance Navigator AI), so letting users connect external MCP servers to that assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows MCP-client support. The OpenAPI spec, OAuth client credentials, and llms.txt are API and discovery surfaces for others to consume; they are not a way to plug MCP tools into the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
